messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["delayed orgasm", "delayed ejaculation", "difficulty reaching orgasm", "delayed or absent ejaculation", "trouble having an orgasm", "difficulty having an orgasm", "oral delayed release capsule", "being unable to have an orgasm", "next dose may be delayed based on the results", "temporary delay in ovulation", "may cause delay in ovulation", "delayed-release", "abnormal ejaculation", "inability to ejaculate", "delayed-release capsules", "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
